properties.displayName: Illustrative: require private network access for Azure OpenAI accounts
properties.description: Implementation example for an infrastructure control. It audits or denies Azure OpenAI accounts when public network access is not explicitly disabled. It does not govern prompts, model behavior, data entitlements, or transaction authorization.
